Class View.MenuButtons

java.lang.Object
Amphipolis.Javadoc.View.MenuButtons
Enclosing class:
View
public static class View.MenuButtons extends Object
Wrapper class for JButton to manage menu and control buttons. Encapsulates initialization, positioning, and common styling logic for the game's interactive buttons.

  • Constructor Details

    • MenuButtons

      public MenuButtons(String name, int x, int y, int w, int h)
      Constructor for MenuButtons. Stores configuration data but does not yet create the Swing component. Pre-condition: Parameters match the desired layout configuration. Post-condition: A new MenuButtons wrapper is created with the specified properties.
      Parameters:
      name - Text/Name of the button.
      x - X position.
      y - Y position.
      w - Width.
      h - Height.

    • ChangeText

      public void ChangeText(String newText)
      Updates the text displayed on the button. Pre-condition: The underlying button has been initialized. Post-condition: The button displays the newText.
      Parameters:
      newText - The string to display.

    • Update

      protected void Update(JPanel panel)
      Instantiates the button (if necessary) and adds it to a standard JPanel. Pre-condition: panel is not null. Post-condition: this.button is initialized and appended to the panel's component list.
      Parameters:
      panel - The target container.

    • Update

      protected void Update(JLayeredPane pane)
      Instantiates the button (if necessary) and adds it to a JLayeredPane. Sets specific properties (like transparency) suitable for layered rendering. Pre-condition: pane is not null. Post-condition: this.button is initialized and added to the JLayeredPane.PALETTE_LAYER.
      Parameters:
      pane - The target layered container.

    • UpdateHelper

      private void UpdateHelper()
      Internal helper to instantiate and configure the JButton properties. Handles font setting, borders, and special logic for the "Help" (?) button. Post-condition: this.button is instantiated, enabled, and styled according to the name property.
